Module sudoku
Package sudoku.model

Class SudokuRules

java.lang.Object
sudoku.model.SudokuRules
public final class SudokuRules extends Object
Sudoku rules for the 6x6 board: checks that a number is not repeated in its row, column or block, finds the cells in conflict, and gives the numbers that can be placed in a cell. It only has static methods and cannot be instantiated.

      public static Set<Position> findConflictsOf(Board board, int row, int column)
      Finds the cells that repeat the number of one specific cell, in its row, column or block. The cell itself is included when there is a conflict.

      board - the board to check
      row - row of the cell
      column - column of the cell
